### When Disobedience Is Required
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/when-disobedience-required
Passage: Acts 4:19-20
Points:
- Scripture calls Christians to be faithful citizens and respect governmental authority under normal circumstances.
- A duty to disobey civil authorities arises whenever human dictates forbid what God commands or command what He forbids.
- Peter and John demonstrated this principle when ordered by religious rulers to cease speaking in Jesus' name.
- True allegiance belongs first to Christ as Lord over all earthly authorities.
- Faithfulness to God in the face of conflicting laws demands prayerful discernment and courage.

### They Had Been With Jesus
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/they-had-been-with-jesus-1323750.html
Passage: Acts 4:13
Points:
- True Christianity is characterized by an active, personal relationship with Jesus rather than empty profession.
- Peter and John exhibited striking boldness before the council despite lacking formal academic credentials.
- Intimate communion with Jesus transformed the disciples so visibly that even their opponents took notice.
- The voice and presence of Christ should be apparent in the everyday conduct of His followers.
- Believers must examine whether an observing world can see that they have truly spent time with Jesus.
